Supported: ordered/repeated bash/sh -e/+e, minus combinations of c/s/e,
file/-c/-s/default-stdin and --/- terminators; set -e/+e, -o/+o errexit/pipefail,

execution frame is separate from stored option and passes through redirects,
functions, source/eval, conditions/and-or/negation. Stage failures remain isolated;
aggregate pipefail/last-status handling is preserved. Bash substitutions clear e;
sh substitutions inherit it. New interpreters reset context/options then apply
their own switches; headerless fallback clears e. Literal invoke returns status
to its caller. Shared budget/signal/sink/descriptor state is not reset.

Protocol: existing allowlisted /bin/bash and /usr/bin/bash accept zero or ONE
literal -e/+e/repeated-e optional argument. No whitespace/quote splitting of that
argument. Existing plain env bash/sh bindings remain. env literal 'bash -e', env
-S, shebang -c and unknown/invalid interpreter forms remain explicit126. Explicit
bash FILE does not apply a recognized header option again; existing unknown
header, permission and invalidUTF8 refusals remain. No new /bin/sh direct allowlist.
Darwin env-single-kernel-argument remains an honest protocol loss, not waived.
No ERR traps, shopt/inherit_errexit option, SHELLOPTS/startup inheritance, nounset,
job control, broad syntax, creation-mask fix or full Bash/parity claim.

argv0 bash/sh. Primary 120/120; historical107/120, thirteen raw differences retained.
